title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #1

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What should you do before the day ends if you have quarrelled with a friend? (1 mark)
   A. Make peace and forgive
   B. Plan revenge
   C. Tell others lies about them
   D. Stop speaking to them

2. Which verse tells Christians to rejoice in the Lord always? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. Philippians 4:4
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. Luke 19:5

3. Which choice is likely to bring a good result? (1 mark)
   A. Skipping class
   B. Doing homework before playing
   C. Copying from a friend
   D. Telling a lie

4. Which verse says that God calls us by name? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. Exodus 20:12
   C. Mark 10:52
   D. Isaiah 43:1

5. Which of these is kind treatment of a donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Overloading it
   B. Leaving it hungry
   C. Beating it
   D. Giving it food, water and rest

6. In which book of the Bible is the story of Samson found? (1 mark)
   A. Judges
   B. Genesis
   C. Luke
   D. Psalms

7. Who first told Pharaoh about Joseph? (1 mark)
   A. The cupbearer
   B. The baker
   C. Potiphar
   D. A magician

8. What was Abram's name changed to? (1 mark)
   A. Jacob
   B. Israel
   C. Abraham
   D. Isaac

9. Why could Zechariah not speak for a time? (1 mark)
   A. He did not believe the angel's words
   B. He was ill
   C. He was tired
   D. He was sad

10. What does "forerunner" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A king
   B. One who follows behind
   C. A teacher of maths
   D. One who goes before to prepare

11. What did Jesus say made Bartimaeus well? (1 mark)
   A. His shouting
   B. His faith
   C. His money
   D. His cloak

12. Who was the one who returned? (1 mark)
   A. A Pharisee
   B. A Samaritan
   C. A priest
   D. A Roman

13. How many came back to thank Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. One
   B. None
   C. Nine
   D. Ten

14. What does Matthew 5:39 teach? (1 mark)
   A. Do not resist an evil person by taking revenge
   B. Hit back harder
   C. Take what is yours
   D. Ignore everyone

15. Who forgave his brothers who had sold him? (1 mark)
   A. Joseph
   B. Samson
   C. Balaam
   D. Daniel

16. Why did Jesus tell the parables in Luke 15? (1 mark)
   A. To entertain
   B. To teach farming
   C. Some leaders complained that He welcomed sinners
   D. To praise money

17. What does the woman's search teach us about money? (1 mark)
   A. Money is unimportant
   B. Hide it always
   C. Lose it quickly
   D. Money is valuable and should be looked after

18. What does being assertive mean? (1 mark)
   A. Saying no to wrong firmly and politely
   B. Being rude
   C. Fighting
   D. Being silent

19. How should we tell the truth? (1 mark)
   A. To hurt
   B. Loudly
   C. With love and respect
   D. Rudely

20. Why should we obey teachers? (1 mark)
   A. They are our enemies
   B. For fun
   C. To be punished
   D. They guide us and help us learn

21. What should you do if an adult tells you to do something that hurts you? (1 mark)
   A. Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   B. Obey
   C. Hide it
   D. Copy it

22. Which verse says that God is love? (1 mark)
   A. 1 John 4:8
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Luke 19:5
   D. Acts 2:38

23. What did God tell the first man to do in the garden, according to Genesis 2:15? (1 mark)
   A. Leave it
   B. Work it and take care of it
   C. Sleep
   D. Sell it

24. Why should a child tell a trusted adult if someone touches them wrongly? (1 mark)
   A. To boast
   B. It is not their fault and the adult can protect them
   C. For no reason
   D. To get someone in trouble

25. What should you do when you sin? (1 mark)
   A. Blame others
   B. Repeat it
   C. Hide it
   D. Confess, say sorry and put things right

26. Why should we take part in church activities? (1 mark)
   A. To show off
   B. To waste time
   C. To grow spiritually and serve others
   D. To avoid home

27. What does "Give us today our daily bread" mean? (1 mark)
   A. We ask for a party
   B. We ask for gold
   C. We ask for money
   D. We ask God for what we need each day

28. When can Christians pray? (1 mark)
   A. Only at night
   B. Only in church
   C. Only on Sunday
   D. Any time and anywhere

29. Which is a good use of a digital device? (1 mark)
   A. Listening to a gospel song
   B. Chatting with strangers
   C. Bullying
   D. Spreading rumours

30. Which of these is personal information to protect? (1 mark)
   A. Your home address
   B. The colour of the sky
   C. A favourite song
   D. The weather

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe the naming of John. (4 marks)

32. Give two examples of personal information that you should not share online. (2 marks)

33. Explain why Jesus cleared the temple. (3 marks)

34. Describe how Stephen died. (3 marks)

35. Explain what the story teaches about gratitude and give one example from school life. (4 marks)

36. List two attributes of God. (2 marks)

37. Name two personal items and one way of caring for each. (2 marks)

38. Explain how knowing that God is holy should affect the way a child behaves. (5 marks)

39. Give two ways of showing love at home. (2 marks)

40. Explain what Proverbs 12:19 means. (3 marks)

41. Explain what it means to repent as taught in Acts 2:38 and how a child can do it. (5 marks)

42. Explain why a child should never blame themselves if they were touched wrongly, and say what they should do. (5 marks)

43. Describe three steps for making a right decision. (3 marks)

44. Describe three steps in planting and caring for a seed. (3 marks)

45. Give two sins that do not please God. (2 marks)

46. Name two fruits of the Spirit and give an example of each. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Make peace and forgive
   Ephesians 4:26 says not to let the sun go down on your anger.

2. B — Philippians 4:4
   Philippians 4:4 says, "Rejoice in the Lord always."

3. B — Doing homework before playing
   Doing your work first helps you learn and stay out of trouble.

4. D — Isaiah 43:1
   Isaiah 43:1 says, "I have called you by name."

5. D — Giving it food, water and rest
   Kindness to animals includes meeting their needs.

6. A — Judges
   Judges 13-16 tells about Samson.

7. A — The cupbearer
   The cupbearer remembered Joseph from prison.

8. C — Abraham
   Genesis 17:5 records the new name.

9. A — He did not believe the angel's words
   Luke 1:20 says he would be silent because he did not believe.

10. D — One who goes before to prepare
   A forerunner goes ahead.

11. B — His faith
   Jesus said, "Your faith has healed you."

12. B — A Samaritan
   The one who returned was a Samaritan.

13. A — One
   Only one returned.

14. A — Do not resist an evil person by taking revenge
   Jesus taught us to break the cycle of revenge.

15. A — Joseph
   Joseph forgave his brothers in Egypt.

16. C — Some leaders complained that He welcomed sinners
   Jesus showed God's love for sinners.

17. D — Money is valuable and should be looked after
   The woman valued her coin.

18. A — Saying no to wrong firmly and politely
   Assertive means standing for what is right.

19. C — With love and respect
   Truth should be told kindly.

20. D — They guide us and help us learn
   Teachers care for our progress and safety.

21. A — Refuse and tell a trusted adult
   Obedience is only for good instructions.

22. A — 1 John 4:8
   1 John 4:8 states that God is love.

23. B — Work it and take care of it
   Genesis 2:15 says this.

24. B — It is not their fault and the adult can protect them
   Telling keeps children safe.

25. D — Confess, say sorry and put things right
   1 John 1:9 says God forgives those who confess.

26. C — To grow spiritually and serve others
   Participation helps faith to grow.

27. D — We ask God for what we need each day
   It refers to daily needs.

28. D — Any time and anywhere
   God hears us always.

29. A — Listening to a gospel song
   Gospel songs are uplifting.

30. A — Your home address
   Never share your address online.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: On the eighth day people wanted to call him Zechariah. Elizabeth said his name is John. They asked Zechariah, who wrote, "His name is John." His speech returned and he praised God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: Home address, school, phone number, passwords, family photos.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: The temple was meant for prayer but people used it to make money and cheat. Jesus cared for the honour of His Father's house.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for prayer purpose, 1 for making money or cheating, 1 for honour of God's house.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: The people were furious at his message, dragged him out of the city and stoned him. He prayed for God to receive his spirit and to forgive them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for anger, 1 for stoning, 1 for prayer.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: Jesus noticed that only one of the ten returned to thank Him. We should be thankful to God and to people. Example: thanking a teacher who helped with a difficult lesson.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the lesson, 1 for Jesus noticing, 1 for a school example, 1 for explanation of gratitude.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: Sole Creator, loving Father, holy. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each attribute.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Uniform: wash it; exercise book: cover it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each item with care.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: God is pure and never does wrong, so we should respect Him, worship Him and try to be holy. We should choose good things, tell the truth, avoid sin, behave well in church and obey His commandments. If we fail, we should say sorry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God being holy, 1 for respect, 1 for choosing good, 1 for avoiding sin or obeying, 1 for saying sorry.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: Obey parents, help with chores, be kind to siblings, care for younger children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Truth lasts and is trusted, but lies are soon found out and do not last.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for truth lasting, 1 for lies not lasting, 1 for clear explanation.

41. (5 marks)
   Answer: Repent means to be sorry for sin and turn away from it. Peter told people to repent and be baptised. A child can admit wrong, tell God sorry, ask forgiveness from others, make a decision to do better and ask the Holy Spirit's help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 for Acts 2:38, 1 for admitting, 1 for saying sorry, 1 for deciding to do better.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: The person who did wrong is always guilty. A child cannot control an adult or older person who chooses to do wrong. The child should tell a trusted adult, who will believe and protect them, and can call 116 for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the person doing wrong being guilty, 1 for the child not being to blame, 1 for telling a trusted adult, 1 for the helper protecting, 1 for the helpline.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stop and think, ask if it pleases God, pray, ask advice, choose the right thing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dig a hole, plant the seed and cover it, water it regularly, protect it, watch it grow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Lying, stealing, disobedience, bullying, jealousy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Love: sharing lunch; kindness: helping a friend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fruit with example.
